name: claude-toolbelt
description: A belt of unrelated Claude Code plugins: a guided branch review, a context hygiene setup, and two ways of surfacing a session's state outside the terminal.

plugins.name: branch-review
plugins.description: Tells you what your branch actually changed — what was done, why, and what deserves a second look, instead of the diff — then files the fixes into the commits they belong to.

plugins.name: clean-context
plugins.description: Keeps a project's noise out of Claude's default context. Today: a managed .ignore, a Glob setting, and a short read-deny list for secrets, leaving every excluded path readable on purpose.

plugins.name: status-icons
plugins.description: Marks the terminal tab with an icon that tells "it is done" apart from "it is blocked on you", where Claude Code shows the same star for both.

plugins.name: status-sounds
plugins.description: Plays a short sound when Claude has finished, has failed, or wants something from you — so you look up at the right moment without watching the tab.
